svg.title: Pip & Pine Bakery X (Twitter) Link card image template
svg.desc: Template 1200x628px. Keep text and logos inside the dashed safe zone. Text colour #ffffff on #5a3a29 = 10.1:1. Delete the "guides" group before export.

text.font-family: 'Fraunces', 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
'Source Sans 3', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
